author: RandomGuyWasHere
body:
While I was away my brother got me banned, he has ADHD meaning that he has a bad temper at times. He has been banned by Darkiur_, for racist behaviour and I am unsure of how to appeal for an infraction.
Please help!
kind regards RandomGuyWasHere--Josh

replies.author: Eteh
replies.body: appeal at "Appeal an Infraction" or send an email to support@avicus.net

replies.body: Thanks I tried appealing but it wouldn't let me ill try to email them.

replies.body: Moved to "Appeal an infraction". Please write a detailed appeal here and refrain from making these threads in the future.

replies.author: RandomGuyWasHere
replies.body:
Hello, I am requesting for an unban of my account this is because my account was banned since my brother played on it without permission and began to make racist slurs. This got my account banned by one of the staff. I believe that I should be given another chance since I have been a loyal member of this fun great server since it started. Please consider unbanning me, Thank you.
Kind regards RandomGuyWasHere--Josh

replies.body:
Hello,

Firstly, you have a history of saying racial and offensive slurs in chat. Secondly, it is your account, and therefore your responsibility.

You will not be appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax/Aeronautic_, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
